name: Strawberry Park Hot Springs
description: Natural hot springs nestled in the mountains near Steamboat Springs. Multiple pools fed by natural geothermal springs with temperatures ranging from 86-102°F. Beautiful outdoor setting surrounded by forest.

name: Quinn's Hot Springs
description: Historic hot springs resort in western Montana offering naturally heated pools. Known for relaxation and therapeutic soaking in scenic mountain surroundings.

name: Kirkham Hot Springs
description: Pristine natural hot springs located along the Middle Fork of the Salmon River. Multiple small pools with temperatures between 95-107°F, accessible via hiking trail through scenic wilderness.

name: Boiling River
description: Natural hot springs located within Yellowstone National Park. The river mixes with cold water creating comfortable soaking temperatures. Popular destination accessible via short walk from parking area.

name: Jemez Springs
description: Traditional hot springs village in northern New Mexico with multiple natural springs throughout the area. Known for spiritual and healing properties, with a bohemian community and outdoor soaking pools.

name: McCredie Hot Springs
description: Undeveloped natural hot springs along Salt Creek in the Cascades. Multiple small pools with varying temperatures from warm to very hot. Popular with locals seeking a primitive soaking experience.

name: Sykes Hot Springs
description: Secluded natural hot springs located in the Big Sur wilderness near the Lost Coast. Requires backpacking through coastal redwood forests. Multiple thermal pools with ocean views.

name: Gerlach Hot Springs
description: Natural hot springs in the Nevada high desert near the Black Rock Desert. Multiple pools with temperatures suitable for soaking. Popular destination for off-the-beaten-path adventures.

name: Crystal Hot Springs
description: Commercial hot springs resort in central Utah offering multiple heated pools and spa services. Developed facility with modern amenities and year-round operation.

name: Chena Hot Springs
description: Alaska's premier hot springs resort located in the interior near Fairbanks. Natural geothermal springs provide year-round soaking in a pristine northern wilderness setting.
